question: How does the fire of awareness burn without fuel?
premises: This fire does not rely on an inner supply of fuel.
It blazes constantly on its own.
Its fierce flames spread through the entire stream of the senses.
inference: The fire of awareness is self-sustaining and continuously illuminates all sensory experience.
uncertainties: 'akṣaugha' may refer to the flood of senses or the flood of eyes; 'senses' fits the broader context.
plain_english: Without relying on any inner supply of fuel, the fire blazes constantly, its fierce flames spreading through the whole stream of the senses.
